items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: Well I never had to do that with Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: That says “I’m not Najee,” and his says “I’m not Onaje.” You know.
Well I never had to do that with Thelonious Monk.
Oh yeah a lot of people ask you where you got that from.
